responseData.name: Lords of War
responseData.description: Who Are We?We are LoW!Resistance is Futile!.Not a relic of the past, but a storm of the present! We dominated GvG like no other, holding Top 1 for 2013 days. Throughout our history, we set major milestones – creating the 1st level 80 Arc in FoE and becoming the 1st guild where every member had a level 80 Arc.Our cause is simple – to be the best of the best.What Do We Offer?Stability – We've been here since 2012, and LoW isn’t going anywhere.Excellence – We represent the finest players on EN7 who keep raising the bar.Teamwork – We work as one and always have each other's backs.Growth – An environment where newbies, intermediates, and veterans can learn, grow, and level up.Equality – Every member matters – everyone contributes to our success.Benefits – We offer BE GB support, Arc leveling incentives, and as a level 100 guild, the best daily FP, construction, and recruitment bonuses.Innovation – We stay ahead of the game, sharing knowledge and improving as a team.Requirements:Era: We accept players from All Era's except LMAArc: Level 80 minimum (ideally Arc 100; we have a BE for All GB's thread and 2.0 for Arcs thread)Guild Goods: Must be working toward:Indy/PE/ME: 2000/dayFE, AF, OF, VF: 2500/daySAM, SAAB, SAV, SAJM: 3000/daySAT: 3500/dayGE: Level 80 is a must on competitive weeksGBG: We do not care how active you are on off seasons, only on competitive matches where we expect you to step up and be maximally activeQI: Minimum 4000 pointsHow to Apply:If you wanna join Lords of War, create a thread and send a group message to everyone with a Crown & a Star.
